title: The tangent space of a translated linear subspace is the subspace
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) be a linear subspace, and let a, y ∈ ℝ^P with y + a ∈ Q. Put A := {z ∈ ℝ^P : z + a ∈ Q} = Q − a. Then tangentSpace A y = Q as subsets of ℝ^P. Here tangentSpace A y is the set of v ∈ ℝ^P for which there is γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ on (−1, 1), maps (−1, 1) into A, satisfies γ(0) = y, and has derivative v at 0 (HasDerivAt γ v 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a y : Euclid P), y + a ∈ Q → tangentSpace {z | z + a ∈ Q} y = (Q : Set (Euclid P))
